default.description: Axis Desktop grants no Tauri permission to any web content. The window loads a remote Axis deployment over http(s), and Tauri only exposes native APIs to origins listed in a capability's `remote.urls`. Because this capability declares no `remote` block, the deployment the user signs in to has zero access to the native shell: it cannot reach the filesystem, the shell, the clipboard or any Tauri command. The opener plugin used to hand off-origin links to the system browser is called from Rust in src/lib.rs, not from JavaScript, so it needs no permission entry here.

deployment.description: Capabilities for the main PACS window only. The deployment origin is runtime-configured, so remote URLs must be broad; src/lib.rs pins main-window navigation to the configured origin. The secondary viewer is created by Rust, uses the same navigation pin, and receives no remote capability. Filesystem access remains scoped to paths that src/file_select.rs grants after a native picker selection.
